comments.text: Pro tip warm up your tires, go at it at 50% for 3 laps get a rhythm then switch it at 70% and play around on the apex’s and try different lines, your car is a Ferrari so it’s a mid rear weight distribution so you wear out the rear tires more that the front so give a couple brake check on corner entry and put load on the front tires and avoid gravel when it’s present on the track to control your rotation give a couple blips to the throttle to avoid oversteer while maintaining a balance on your counter steer to fully rotate the car to your preferred line, the dive bombing was nice on the 100 meter mark but braking early and letting the throttle go and coasting while your opponent brakes further to find his apex gives you an advantage say you gave it fill brake and slowly trail braking on the 160 meter mark should give shred your gap to the car in front of you
